quarter.en: Q3 2026 (first profitable quarter as a public company)
quarter.zh: 2026年第三季（上市后首个盈利季度）

en: Revenue rose 161% to $14.58B, well above the ~$12.9B consensus, and SpaceX turned its first profit as a public company: $2.8B operating income, $4.4B net income and $0.35 EPS against roughly $0.13 expected. Super Intelligence tripled to $7.56B and became the largest segment; Starlink grew 69% to $5.25B. CFO Bret Johnsen guided Q4 capex to $35–40B, Q1 2027 revenue to $33–37B and a $100B run rate by December, citing a $63B backlog. Musk targets about 3 GW of compute by year-end and at least 10 GW more in 2027, and confirmed special committees are weighing a Tesla merger.

Shares closed at $147.79 before the report, then jumped 7.8% to $159.31 in the first session on a Q1 2027 guide far above the ~$22B modeled. The gain vanished next day: the stock fell 9.1% to $144.75 on twice normal volume as a tech selloff after Meta's report met the expiry of lockups on about 1.3 billion shares and worries over Q4 capex. It then traded between $145 and $149, closing Oct 28 at $145.23, 1.7% below the pre-report close.
zh: 营收增长 161% 至 145.8 亿美元，远超约 129 亿美元的预期；SpaceX 实现上市后首次盈利：营业利润 28 亿、净利润 44 亿美元，每股收益 $0.35，预期约 $0.13。超级智能收入增至三倍达 75.6 亿，成为最大板块；星链增长 69% 至 52.5 亿。CFO 布雷特·约翰森指引第四季资本开支 350–400 亿、2027 年第一季营收 330–370 亿，并称12月年化收入可达 1000 亿，依据为 630 亿未完成订单。马斯克目标年底算力约 3 GW、2027 年再增至少 10 GW，并确认特别委员会正评估与特斯拉合并。

财报前股价收于 147.79 美元，首个交易日因 2027 年第一季营收指引远高于约 220 亿美元的预测，大涨 7.8% 至 159.31 美元。次日涨幅全数回吐：Meta 财报后科技股遭抛售，约 13 亿股禁售到期，加上市场担忧第四季资本开支，股价在两倍于平日的成交量下大跌 9.1% 至 144.75 美元。此后在 145 至 149 美元间震荡，10 月 28 日收于 145.23 美元，较财报前收盘价低 1.7%。

bio.en: Founded SpaceX in 2002 to make life multiplanetary; it now leads in rocket launches and runs Starlink. Merged in his AI company xAI in February 2026, took SpaceX public in June in the largest IPO ever, and controls about 82% of the votes. Also Tesla's CEO.
bio.zh: 2002 年创立 SpaceX，目标是让人类成为多星球物种；公司如今在火箭发射领域领先并运营星链。2026 年 2 月并入其 AI 公司 xAI，6 月完成史上最大 IPO，掌握约 82% 投票权。同时担任特斯拉 CEO。

bio.en: SpaceX CFO since 2011, after nearly a decade in finance at Broadcom, where he rose from controller roles. Ran the xAI merger, the June 2026 IPO and the $60B Cursor deal, and now manages $89.9B of cash and securities against a $35–40B quarterly capex bill.
bio.zh: 2011 年起任 SpaceX CFO，此前在博通财务部门工作近十年，从多个业务的财务主管做起。主导了 xAI 合并、2026 年 6 月 IPO 及 600 亿美元 Cursor 收购，现管理 899 亿美元现金及证券，应对每季 350–400 亿的资本开支。

sources.t: Next-day reversal and lockup expiry (Business Insider)
